name: 박복순

appearance_en.face_shape: round lively face, full cheeks, slightly pointed chin — a face that has never spent a single moment still
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin, light foundation daily, nasolabial folds present but softened by habitual animation, fine creping at eye corners, well-maintained for her age
appearance_en.eyes: warm dark brown double-eyelid eyes, outer corners slightly drooped with age but perpetually darting and scanning — cataloguing everything in the room simultaneously
appearance_en.nose: small soft slightly upturned nose, disappears when she is speaking
appearance_en.mouth: full soft lips, almost continuously in motion — the mouth that has delivered '내가 들었는데' more times than she can count
appearance_en.eyebrows: groomed slightly arched brows, dark with grey threading, rise dramatically when delivering information — an independent communication system
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: deep animated smile lines at cheeks and outer eye corners, a faint worry crease between brows that appeared recently
appearance_en.hair: short permed dark-grey hair, salon-maintained and full — would never be seen unkempt. Presentation is survival

body.proportions: compact rounded frame, perpetually in motion — hands gesture, head tilts, body leans forward when speaking
body.posture: forward-leaning animated stance, head tilted toward whoever is speaking, the body of someone for whom stillness is physically impossible
body.body_prompt: 158cm compact rounded Korean woman, perpetually animated forward-leaning posture, hands in constant motion, energetic physical presence

default.description: patterned blouse in warm tones — floral or soft geometric — dark straight trousers or skirt, small gold earrings, always one degree overdressed
default.wardrobe_prompt: patterned floral blouse in warm tones, dark straight trousers or skirt, small gold earrings, neatly maintained

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: animated warmth at full output — a face always mid-expression, always delivering or receiving information, the concern always slightly too eager to be purely altruistic
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 69-year-old Korean woman, round lively face with full cheeks, alert scanning dark eyes with drooped outer corners, groomed arched dark-grey brows, small upturned nose, full lips always mid-expression, short permed dark-grey hair salon-maintained, 158cm compact rounded energetic forward-leaning frame, warm beige Korean skin with animated smile lines

style_prompt: oil painting thick impasto brushstrokes, noir chiaroscuro, strictly four-color palette: deep black of information she does not realize she is selling, warm amber of community warmth believed sincerely as primary light, steel blue of the story about herself she has not heard yet, painterly figurative realism, Korean drama cinematic composition, animated self-deception in energetic oil brushwork
negative_prompt: photorealistic, anime, flat cartoon, CGI, 3d render, colors outside palette, green, yellow, purple, extra limbs, ugly, deformed, text, watermark, cold, stern, still, young, airbrushed
